questions.question: How does Python's GIL affect threading for CPU-bound tasks?
questions.expected_answer: Threads do not provide real speedup for CPU-bound work because only one thread executes Python bytecode at a time. Use multiprocessing for true parallelism.

questions.question: Is threading still useful for I/O-bound tasks in Python?
questions.expected_answer: Yes — the GIL is released during blocking I/O, so other threads can run.
